measures.name: Load Factor
measures.dax: DIVIDE(SUM('Main Data'[# Transported Passengers]), SUM('Main Data'[# Available Seats]))

measures.name: Performed vs Scheduled
measures.dax: DIVIDE(SUM('Main Data'[# Departures Performed]), SUM('Main Data'[# Departures Scheduled]))

measures.name: Air Time %
measures.dax: DIVIDE(SUM('Main Data'[# Air Time]), SUM('Main Data'[# Ramp-To-Ramp Time]))

measures.name: Carrier
measures.dax: IF(DISTINCTCOUNTNOBLANK('Link Table'[Carrier Name]) = 1, MAX('Link Table'[Carrier Name]), "Others")

measures.name: Air Time % (CH21)
measures.dax: DIVIDE(SUM('Main Data'[# Air Time]), SUM('Main Data'[# Ramp-To-Ramp Time]))

calculated_dimensions.qlik:
=if([Flight Type]='Domestic, US Carriers Only', 'Open',
if([Flight Type]='International, Foreign Carriers', 'Negotiating', 'Closed'))
calculated_dimensions.dax: SWITCH([Flight Type], "Domestic, US Carriers Only", "Open", "International, Foreign Carriers", "Negotiating", "Closed")

semantic_gaps: Link table: [Link Table] is not unique on [%Key Field] (10,073 rows, 10,068 keys; five Antonov keys carry Carrier Codes ADB and AUQ), so Main Data and Employment Statistics relate to it many-to-many, filtered from the link table. As in QlikView, a flight row of such a key counts once in totals and under each of its Carrier Codes.

Fields on the link table (Year, Month, Quarter, Period, carrier names, Airlines, Carrier Groups) filter both facts; fields on one fact (e.g. Flight Type) do not filter the link table or the other fact. QlikView propagates selections in every direction; with no selections (the parity baseline) the results are the same.

Null-key 'Unknown' members the script adds (Carrier Groups: 12 flight rows without a carrier group) are not loaded: they associate with nothing in QlikView and would wrongly match blank keys in Power BI (7 vs 8 rows).

Aircraft Types: MAPPING LOAD / ApplyMap -> left merge on the first Country per manufacturer ('Unknown' when missing); LEFT JOIN -> merge; the script's STORE into Aircraft Types Transformed.qvd is not reproduced. QlikView trims unquoted text in delimited files, so the Aircraft_Group.csv labels are trimmed.
Field and table comments from Comments.xls (COMMENT ... USING) are not migrated; config.qvs / tracerowcount.qvs are not in the repo and only set paths / log row counts.
Calculated dimension: the Flight Type deal status -> calculated column on Flight Types.

List boxes -> slicers on the field named by the list box's caption: Year, Quarter, Month, Flight Type, Carrier's Operating Region, Carrier Group, Carrier Name (Dashboard, Analysis, Reports); 11 origin / destination / carrier / distance fields (Associations); Aircraft Name, Year (Data Consistency). Associations' 'Aircraft Type' (LB10) and 'Aircraft Group' (LB11) name no field of this model and are not migrated.

Multi boxes MB01 'Flight Information' and MB02 'Aircraft' -> one slicer per field they contain, on the Dashboard, Analysis and Reports pages. Text objects, search object, buttons, bookmark object, current selections box, container, statistics box and table box have no Power BI equivalent and are not migrated; gauges become cards and the radar, mekko, grid, funnel and block charts are not rebuilt (their measures are in the model).
